1.consolidated_definition: Cinta adhesiva reforzada con filamentos de diversos materiales que se usa para empacar. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Debes ponerle strapping tape, porque el paquete es muy pesado (ejemplo creado)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Strapping tape reinforced with filaments of various materials used for packaging. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. You should use strapping tape because the package is very heavy (example created)
